name: tier-c-league
description: Tier C League: a free habit league for friends. A Nunchucks Production.

scripts.test:rules: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tier-c "vitest run --project rules --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p jobs/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all
scripts.checkpoint:b: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tier-c "vitest run --project rules --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=.vitest/rules.json" && node scripts/checkpoint-b.ts
scripts.dev: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-tier-c "npm run dev -w app -- --mode emulator"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-tier-c "playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts --trace off"
